purpose: Teach: まわし/近づき/ウサギ/改札/加熱/旨い/ヤバイ/思いつく

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ハンドルまわし、上手いよな、自転車。
lines.en: Riku — you're actually pretty good at handling your bike, aren't you.
lines.style: Light, teasing observation. Casual delivery. A compliment disguised as a lazy comment. Slight upward lilt at the end—expecting agreement.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。あいつ、最近、お前に近づきたいみたいだぜ、桜。
lines.en: Yeah. That guy's been trying to get closer to you lately, Sakura.
lines.style: Neutral probe, watching her face. Deliberate pause before the name. Not quite a question—more like testing what she'll say. Cool distance maintained.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 家の隣、ウサギ、飼い始めたって、聞いた?
lines.en: Did you hear? The neighbor's started keeping a rabbit.
lines.style: Bright subject-shift. Quick, genuine interest. Not forced—just moving on to something else. Slightly higher energy than before.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 改札、Suica、忘れたら、めっちゃ困るよな、リク。
lines.en: Man, if you forget your Suica at the gate it's such a hassle, right?
lines.style: Conversational, almost talking to himself. Wry observation about life's small frustrations. Doesn't require a real answer—just speaking the obvious out loud.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お弁当、レンジで加熱したら、香りが、すごかったよ。
lines.en: When I heated my lunch in the microwave, the smell was crazy.
lines.style: Animated but grounded. Genuine small enthusiasm—not performing. Slight laugh underneath. The kind of thing you mention because it actually happened and it was kind of funny.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 近所の新しいラーメン屋、めっちゃ旨いって、聞いたぜ。
lines.en: I heard the new ramen place nearby is supposed to be really good.
lines.style: Casual recommendation, slight brightness. Testing the waters—genuine interest without pushing. Easy tone, like he's sharing something he actually wants to talk about.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活、ヤバイ、来週、強豪と試合だよ、緊張する。
lines.en: My club's got a match next week against a really strong team. I'm kind of nervous about it.
lines.style: Animated energy with real tension underneath. The nerves are genuine. Speaking a little faster than usual. Vulnerability peeking through the brightness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試合の戦略、寝てる時、ふと思いつくこと、あるんだよな、俺。
lines.en: Sometimes when I'm falling asleep, strategies for the match just come to me out of nowhere.
lines.style: Reflective, almost wonder-filled. Speaking more slowly here. Genuine puzzlement at how his mind works. Quiet amazement. Trailing off slightly—like he's noticing it for the first time by saying it aloud.
